sprintName: Master Gradebook, Multi-Dimensional Analytics & Export Engine
goals: Deliver student personal quiz performance overview sorted by surname or score
Build Faculty Master Gradebook with mandatory separation of records by year level and section
Support PDF and Excel export generation with dedicated multi-sheet layouts

issues.title: [Gradebook] Student Personal Quiz Results Summary
issues.description: Student dashboard displaying personal quiz scores, passing status, breakdown of attempts, filterable and sortable by surname or score.

issues.title: [Gradebook] Faculty Master Gradebook with Mandatory Separated Records by Year Level & Section
issues.description: Faculty analytics matrix showing all student scores categorized into distinct, mandatory separated datasets/tabs for each Year Level and Section, with multi-column sorting (Surname, Score).

issues.title: [Export] PDF and Excel Spreadsheet Export Engine
issues.description: Generate clean, downloadable PDF reports and formatted Excel (.xlsx) spreadsheets for both student summary reports and faculty master gradebook tables.

issues.title: [Gradebook] Faculty Multi-Dimensional Filter Engine with Mandatory Segregated Tabs by Year Level & Section
issues.description: Build high-performance table view segregating student records strictly by Year Level and Section into distinct tabs, with real-time multi-criteria filtering by surname search, score brackets, and completion status.

issues.title: [Export] Institutional Multi-Sheet Excel (.xlsx) Report Generator with Separate Sheets per Year Level & Section
issues.description: Implement automated workbook generation creating separate spreadsheet tabs/sheets for each Year Level and Section with formatted grade summary headers, average scores, and pass/fail indicators.

issues.title: [Export] Formal PDF Gradebook & Student Report Card Exporter with Institutional Branding & Verification Signatures
issues.description: Implement publication-grade PDF generation with institutional Quikz academic header, student alphabetical indexing by surname, score breakdowns, 75% benchmark badges, and certified faculty sign-off sections.
